nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the caching infrastructure for system prompt assembly: bounded caches for rendered sections, skill listings, learnings, and git branch lookups, plus cache-break tracking for diagnosing prompt-cache invalidations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a SkillListingCacheKey capturing the workspace root, disabled skills, include filter, agent id, and resource-loading flag that determine skill-listing cache identity.

nodes.name: new_entries_for_agent
nodes.summary: Computes which skill-listing entries are new for a given agent since the last time listings were sent, supporting incremental catalog updates.

nodes.name: volatile_context_reminder_message
nodes.summary: Builds the reminder message text appended to volatile (non-cacheable) system prompt context.

nodes.name: attach_volatile_context_reminder
nodes.summary: Attaches a volatile-context reminder message to the message list when volatile system blocks are present, preventing prompt-cache staleness.

nodes.name: rendered_system_blocks_from_messages
nodes.summary: Extracts previously rendered system blocks (with their cache scope) from a message history.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Records a sample of a turn's cache-hit/break behavior (system/tools/model hashes and token counts) for cache-break diagnostics.

nodes.name: get_or_fetch
nodes.summary: Returns the cached current git branch for a repo path, fetching and caching it if not already known.

nodes.name: PromptCacheInvalidationReason
nodes.summary: Enum enumerating the reasons a prompt cache may need to be invalidated (session reset, agent definition change, workspace change, etc.).

nodes.name: PromptCachePolicy
nodes.summary: Enum defining how a prompt section's cache lifetime is governed: stable, revision-keyed, or volatile.

nodes.name: CacheStats
nodes.summary: Tracks hit/miss/entry counters for a cache.

nodes.name: SessionPromptCache
nodes.summary: Bounded cache of rendered prompt sections keyed by section id, used to avoid re-rendering unchanged sections.

nodes.name: SkillListingCacheKey
nodes.summary: Composite key identifying a cached skill listing by the parameters that affect its contents.

nodes.name: SkillListingDeltaStats
nodes.summary: Tracks how many skill entries were scanned, are new, were sent, or were suppressed in a listing delta.

nodes.name: SkillListingCache
nodes.summary: Cache of skill listings per agent that tracks which entries have already been sent, enabling incremental delta updates.

nodes.name: LearningsPromptCacheKey
nodes.summary: Composite key identifying a cached learnings-section render by agent scope, row count, and revision.

nodes.name: LearningsPromptCache
nodes.summary: Bounded cache of rendered learnings prompt sections keyed by scope and revision.

nodes.name: RenderedSystemBlockScope
nodes.summary: Enum describing the cache scope of a rendered system prompt block.

nodes.name: RenderedSystemBlock
nodes.summary: A rendered system prompt block paired with its cache scope, used to reconstruct prior prompt state.

nodes.name: CacheBreakSample
nodes.summary: A single sample recording whether a turn's prompt caused a provider cache break, along with contributing hashes and token counts.

nodes.name: CacheBreakStats
nodes.summary: Aggregated cache-break statistics (sample count, break count, last sample) for diagnosing prompt cache instability.

nodes.name: PromptCacheBreakTracker
nodes.summary: Tracks recent cache-break samples to help diagnose why a provider's prompt cache is breaking between turns.

nodes.name: GitBranchCache
nodes.summary: Caches the current git branch per repository path to avoid repeated git invocations during prompt building.

nodes.name: gui_control_retrieval.rs
nodes.summary: Scores and retrieves GUI control cards relevant to a user's message, used to surface applicable GUI-control documentation/snippets in the system prompt.

nodes.name: score_card
nodes.summary: Scores a GUI control card's relevance to a user query using normalized term matching.

nodes.name: build_gui_control_relevant_controls_section
nodes.summary: Builds the system prompt section listing GUI controls most relevant to the user's latest message.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: General-purpose helpers used across system prompt building: loading project conventions/memory files, truncating and formatting text for prompt budgets, and rendering workspace path and additional-directory context.

nodes.name: load_conventions
nodes.summary: Loads project convention/memory files (e.g. AGENTS.md) from the workspace, expanding any nested memory imports.

nodes.name: expand_memory_imports
nodes.summary: Expands import-style references within a memory/convention file into their referenced content.

nodes.name: cap_text
nodes.summary: Truncates text to a maximum byte length, appending a label when truncation occurs.

nodes.name: format_tool_summaries
nodes.summary: Formats a list of tool summaries into prompt-ready text.

nodes.name: truncate_at_boundary
nodes.summary: Truncates a string at the nearest character boundary not exceeding a maximum length.

nodes.name: list_project_slugs
nodes.summary: Lists known project slugs available on disk.

nodes.name: resolve_workspace_path_string
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective workspace path string from session config.

nodes.name: render_channel_additional_dirs_block
nodes.summary: Renders the prompt block listing additional directories available in a channel session.

nodes.name: append_personal_workspace_context
nodes.summary: Appends personal workspace path context lines to the prompt.

nodes.name: ide_context.rs
nodes.summary: Formats IDE context (open files, selection, diagnostics) into a system prompt section.

nodes.name: format_ide_context
nodes.summary: Formats the current IDE context (open file, selection, diagnostics) into prompt-ready text.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the prompt subsystem, re-exporting builder, cache, gui_control_retrieval, helpers, ide_context, registry, section_builders, section_tests, and sections submodules.

nodes.name: registry.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the PromptSection trait and the prompt assembly registry that orders, evaluates, caches, and renders all system prompt sections into the final unified system prompt (with and without prompt caching).

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a PromptCtx for a session, capturing config, tool summaries, and session-type flags used by section applicability checks.

nodes.name: render_revision_keyed_section
nodes.summary: Renders a revision-keyed prompt section, using the learnings cache when the section's content revision hasn't changed.

nodes.name: assemble_with_cache
nodes.summary: Assembles the full system prompt from all applicable sections, using the session prompt cache to skip re-rendering unchanged sections.

nodes.name: assemble_split_with_cache
nodes.summary: Assembles the system prompt split into cacheable and volatile parts, applying section-level cache policies.

nodes.name: registry
nodes.summary: Returns the ordered registry of all PromptSection implementations that make up the system prompt.

nodes.name: PromptCtx
nodes.summary: Context passed to every prompt section's applicability and render logic, bundling session config, tool info, and session-type flags.

nodes.name: AppliesDecision
nodes.summary: Enum result of a prompt section's applicability check, with an optional skip reason for tracing.

nodes.name: PromptSource
nodes.summary: Enum indicating whether a prompt section's content is builtin, loaded from an override file, or computed.

nodes.name: PromptSection
nodes.summary: Trait implemented by every system prompt section, defining its id, ordering, applicability, rendering, and cache policy.

nodes.name: SectionTrace
nodes.summary: Diagnostic record capturing how a single prompt section was evaluated and rendered, used for prompt debugging/dumping.
